scope: Conditional abstract precedent claims and selected proof handoffs only; structural audit, not assumption truth, semantic completeness, mechanized induction or implementation refinement.

premises.statement: Published root contents have immutable value semantics; view/staging paths do not mutate an existing authored root.
premises.failure: Reject an invalid publication path; retained-root mutation is a contract fault, not a new revision.
premises.open: Prove concrete ownership/alias safety and all mutation-path refinement.

premises.statement: New identities are fresh against every retained/reachable identity in the declared incarnation domain, not merely different from the current root.
premises.failure: Do not reuse a live identity or wrap a bounded counter into an old reference; allocation/exhaustion behavior needs its profile.
premises.open: Specify bounded IDs/incarnations and prove freshness across retained roots and captures.

premises.statement: Snapshot/inverse/context ownership, retention and arithmetic domains remain valid for admitted work.
premises.failure: Refuse unsupported admission/availability rather than free live storage or silently overflow.
premises.open: Concrete finite budgets, checked arithmetic, ownership and reclamation refinement.

premises.statement: A finite batch has exact original-snapshot coordinates and a canonical order with nonoverlapping interiors and explicitly resolved touching insertion ambiguity.
premises.boundary: Target lowering and final edit admission
premises.failure: Reject unresolved ambiguity, stale revisions or overlapping interiors before authored publication.
premises.open: Canonicalizer, insertion profiles and actual multi-selection lowering/refinement; D02/D45.

premises.statement: Source slices and inserted content satisfy the declared UTF-8 scalar-boundary/fidelity contract.
premises.failure: Reject invalid UTF-8 or scalar-splitting endpoints; do not round or normalize silently.
premises.open: Concrete codec/boundary oracle and conformance; no grapheme law follows from sequence algebra.

premises.statement: The complete required participant vector is staged, validated and exposed through one synchronized root capture/publication boundary.
premises.boundary: Final local publication and snapshot capture
premises.failure: Publish none on prepublication failure; do not expose a partially staged companion vector.
premises.open: Participant completeness, synchronization/memory-order and actual observation/refinement proof.

premises.statement: Group keys distinguish all incompatible authors, intent/context and unrelated plans; append/close transitions cover the actual lifecycle.
premises.failure: Do not join incompatible/closed groups merely because of time proximity.
premises.open: Actual group-key completeness, join authority, typing profile and retention/frontier refinement; D13/D14.

premises.statement: UI and agent lowering yield the same canonical request and current context when claiming equivalent behavior.
premises.failure: Reject unsupported/stale conversion; do not retarget through focus or claim equivalence from matching display text.
premises.open: Actual adapters, schemas, outcome/event equivalence and native-order conformance; D29/D33/D45.

premises.statement: Admission and publication use truthful current authority, revisions and all relevant dependency/context checks, not discovery-time permission.
premises.failure: Deny or reject stale/unsupported context; metadata discovery is never authority.
premises.open: Concrete accepted-context/grant/dependency evaluation and validation-to-publication synchronization.

premises.statement: Supplied independent regions form valid contextual source intervals with correct delimiters, nesting/precedence and maps.
premises.boundary: Region discovery and contextual result acceptance
premises.failure: Do not accept ambiguous/unsupported maps or concatenate independent fences implicitly.
premises.open: Actual discovery/partition validation, parser/query assets and boundary profiles; D25/D26.

premises.statement: Each setting-specific combiner and resolver preserves its declared typed value/scope/conflict rules.
premises.failure: Reject invalid combinations without installing a partial context.
premises.open: Concrete setting catalog, combiner laws, scope/order and keymap validation; D34.

premises.statement: The declared configuration dependency relation includes every dependency needed for an unaffected-consumer claim.
premises.failure: Do not reuse under unsupported completeness evidence; conservative invalidation is an available design option, not selected here.
premises.open: Dependency completeness and concrete invalidation/refinement, not merely a dependency-frame implication.

premises.statement: Initial and candidate contexts are actually compatible, activated as one unit, and retained while admitted work references them.
premises.failure: No partial activation or unloading code in use; exact old-compatible/plaintext/exhaustion behavior remains a profile decision.
premises.open: Compatibility validator, atomic activation, bounded retained generations and fallback profiles; D24/D35.

premises.statement: Accepted receipt observations have truthful provider provenance and exact historical identity/content attribution.
premises.failure: Do not grant success/baseline authority to unauthenticated, mismatched, contradictory or unsupported evidence.
premises.open: Actual provider/receipt validation and safe-disposition contracts; D07/D15/D16/D23.

premises.statement: Facts joined in the evidence relation belong to one fixed captured attempt/identity domain; out-of-order observations remain attributable.
premises.boundary: Attempt allocation, late evidence and evidence projection
premises.failure: Do not join unrelated attempts or erase unresolved effect facts at cancellation, rebinding or terminal control.
premises.open: Actual attempt/incarnation/expiry/dedup and reconciliation/refinement contracts; D03/D16/D23.

premises.statement: Each new recipient release passes current scope/grant/lifecycle and field-projection checks; retained knowledge is not recalled by revocation.
premises.failure: Do not treat prepared data, namespaces or historical snapshots as permission for a new release.
premises.open: Concrete recipient fields/tokens/handoff and observation schemas; D09-D12/D36-D38/D42.

premises.statement: The trusted solver, encodings, authored inductions and prose-to-formula correspondence faithfully support only their stated scope.
premises.failure: Reject stale/incomplete/unknown/error results and unsupported claim promotion.
premises.open: Proof-kernel replay, independent correspondence/oracle review and evidence-policy selection; D40/D48.

premises.statement: A supported provider profile supplies actual write/sync/error/attribute semantics; observed acknowledgments do not prove universal physical durability.
premises.failure: Do not report unsupported sync/durability guarantees or infer unknown effects are absent.
premises.open: Actual provider procedure and physical fault/crash conformance; D15/D21/D23.

claims.limit: Fresh-root value laws and authored induction, not actual ownership/reclamation or every mutation path.
Authored finite canonical-list content/inverse theorem; no canonicalizer or byte/profile implementation proof.
Direct namespace-update frame and conditional insertion-range order; no default/deletion/whole-map or authorization theorem.
Coherent abstract pinned-root observations; no concrete staging/memory-order/recipient or external atomicity proof.
Group identity/closure induction; no arbitrary linked-history retention or concrete typing/undo refinement.
Equal lowered inputs under equal current context, not actual lowering/outcomes/public vocabulary or descriptor privacy proof.
Consequences of a valid contextual partition/map, not actual discovery/parser or crossing/precedence proof.
Conditional frame/compatible-pair laws, not typed-combiner/dependency-truth/retention/activation implementation proof.
Monotone fixed-attempt observations and derived corroboration, not uncontested success, receipt truth or physical durability.

handoffs.input: One coherent captured root per observation
handoffs.open: Concrete root representation, capture synchronization and retention must correspond; a pairwise distinct-root VC does not allocate fresh IDs.
Reference scan must use the admitted snapshot rather than reread mutable/current source.

handoffs.output: Canonical source change and coordinate delta
handoffs.open: Full attachment profiles/composition are absent; insertion order laws do not prove deleted identity or map all namespaces.

handoffs.output: Captured inverse chain for exact staged text
handoffs.open: Need real inverse storage and all participant/frontier checks; content recovery alone does not authorize undo.
History membership/linked companions must be part of the actual staged vector, not appended after source publication.
Admission eligibility cannot substitute for final currentness checks after preparation; shared facade is not proof of synchronization.
Source-content framing must be combined with region/context invalidation; unchanged bytes do not prove unchanged parse meaning.

handoffs.input: Region evidence uses the accepted context
handoffs.open: Actual parser/query/region generations and acceptance-time checks must correspond; dependency completeness is still assumed.

handoffs.input: Canonical request interpreted in one context
handoffs.open: A bounded reference pathway now checks captured interpretation, compatible current context and final publication. Concrete schema/producer-consumer correspondence and actual lowering remain unbound; the shared trust premise does not discharge them.

boundedEvidence.scope: One pending command/document and two interpretation contexts; actual EditorContracts splice/map/inverse operators, not its complete temporal relation. Cosmetic/relevant changes, source edits, revocation, cancellation, context retention and diagnostic off/full/fault. No actual schema/compatibility validator, callbacks, native/physical effects, liveness or implementation refinement.

handoffs.open: Capture identity, serialization and provider-attempt evidence must match; equal content or tokens alone are not causal proof.

handoffs.input: Save evidence describes that historical state
handoffs.open: Physical effects and late receipts remain outside local atomic publication; current release policy must still gate any new projection.
